method: Pearson correlation on game-level season totals from nflverse play-by-play (mirror of official NFL feeds), weeks 1-10. Game-level correlations are NOT the correlation of specific prop legs against a line; they are a descriptive starting point and must be re-estimated against actual prop lines before any parlay use.
calculator: nfl-correlation.html provides a Bernoulli-covariance calculator: P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B) + ρ·√(P(A)(1−P(A))P(B)(1−P(B)))
